title: CDR
text: Models a clock data recovery circuit, 1 input; {CDR Mode} determines CDR, {Phase Detector} sets the clock phase detector, {Phase Offset (symbol time)} sets the clock phase offset, {Reference offset (ppm)} sets the reference clock offset impairment, {Early/late count threshold} sets the early or late CDR count threshold to trigger phase, {Step (symbol time)} sets the clock phase resolution, {Frequency tracking gain} sets the internal gain for frequency tracking, {Frequency tracking update}, {Frequency step ramp} sets the number of symbol times required for initial internal frequency tracking gain to reach specified, {Sensitivity (V)} sets the sampling latch metastability voltage, {Phase Offset} and {Reference offset}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Phase Detector
params.values: Clock phase detector option BangBang (default) | BaudRateTypeA

params.name: Phase Offset (symbol time)
params.values: Clock phase offset 0 (default) | real scalar in the range [-0.5,0.5]

params.name: Reference offset (ppm)
params.values: Reference clock offset impairment 0 (default) | real scalar in the range [0, 300]

params.name: Early/late count threshold
params.values: Early or late CDR count threshold to trigger phase update 16 (default) | real positive integer ≥5

params.name: Frequency tracking gain
params.values: Internal gain for frequency tracking 0.00048828125 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Frequency tracking update
params.values: Frequency tracking update 16 (default) | nonnegative integer scalar

params.name: Frequency step ramp
params.values: Number of symbol times required for initial internal frequency tracking gain to reach specified value 3000 (default) | nonnegative integer scalar

params.name: Sensitivity (V)
params.values: Sampling latch metastability voltage 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Phase Offset
params.values: Include Phase Offset parameter in IBIS-AMI model on (default) | off

params.name: Reference offset
params.values: Include Reference offset parameter in IBIS-AMI model on (default) | off
